---
title: "Electricity"
description: "Understanding power use in one household."
---

## The everyday decision

What can a household's electricity measurements reveal about when and how
energy is used?

## The evidence

The [UCI household power dataset](https://archive.ics.uci.edu/dataset/235/individual+household+electric+power+consumption)
records one home in France at one-minute intervals from December 2006 to
November 2010. It includes missing readings and submetering, but not electricity
prices. Results about this household should not be presented as population-wide
or current bill estimates.

## Status

The June 5, 2024 coverage slot is a topic label, not a work date. Its
retrospective analysis ran on November 14, 2026; the draft remains excluded
and has no publication date. The exact
[analysis revision](https://github.com/dckodi-glitch/electricity-changes/blob/16e57642f3bb5fc21a62bc84f48550f83cbd9081/analysis/household_power.py)
matches the recorded source hash, although the working tree was dirty when

[revision `929ed43064487e09fe69af58f5c43d5971fa14a4`](https://github.com/dckodi-glitch/electricity-changes/commit/929ed43064487e09fe69af58f5c43d5971fa14a4).

The July 3, 2024 e02 completeness proposal overlaps missing-marker, duplicate
timestamp and daily-coverage checks already reported by e01; no separate e02

retrospectively on November 24, 2026. Its exact source snapshot is preserved
with the excluded draft (SHA-256
`ac056b355793410ea6a8206844051510a0a56350cb8051d99ebbcb4584c002c3`) and
[committed source revision](https://github.com/dckodi-glitch/electricity-changes/blob/2d94f2982173471a49379bcb45e537ebba23f35b/analysis/household_power.py).
It used input revision `929ed43064487e09fe69af58f5c43d5971fa14a4`; the source
was committed and clean at execution. The draft remains excluded with no
publication date. The September 4, 2024 e04 weekday/weekend comparison is
still proposed, with no results or post asserted.

The public electricity repository history begins on November 13, 2026; it
does not establish when work outside GitHub occurred. At source snapshot
[`e69fadb`](https://github.com/dckodi-glitch/electricity-changes/tree/e69fadb3089e96e8dd9ea812559d840dddf13d6c),
the committed exports include daily active-energy and coverage data
byte-identical to e01's, plus the e03 hourly profile, but no monthly
aggregation or submeter summary.

The October 2, 2024 e05 proposal now reuses e01's daily CSV, metadata and
quality summary to aggregate monthly energy and flag partial boundary or
incomplete months; no monthly result is claimed. The November 6 e06 proposal
uses the same daily export for a distinct complete-day distribution and
excluded-day count, rather than recalculating daily energy. The December 4
e07 proposal remains planned: the current analysis outputs do not summarize
the three submetering channels, whose units and missingness still need
validation. None of e05–e07 has a verified execution date or publication;
their posts remain excluded. The other ten coverage dates from September 11
through December 4, 2024 remain unassigned because no distinct weekly
milestone is supported.

For the next coverage window, the January 1 e08 residual remains dependent on
e07's pending submeter validation. The February 5 e09 seasonal comparison can
reuse e01's complete-day flags and e03's hourly method, but no seasonal
profiles exist yet; season boundaries must be declared, and the source
timezone is unspecified. The March 5 e10 voltage distribution remains
proposed because the current outputs contain no voltage analysis or
missingness summary. None of e08–e10 has an execution date, result, or
publication; their drafts remain excluded. The other ten coverage dates from
December 11, 2024 through March 5, 2025 remain unassigned.

The April 2 e11 proposal reuses e01's daily aggregates to compare strict
1,440-valid-minute inclusion with a labeled 95% sensitivity threshold (at
least 1,368 valid minutes) on full calendar days. It will report observed
energy without filling missing readings; incomplete-day sums are not full-day
estimates, and no sensitivity result exists. The May 7 e12 synthesis depends
on e05, e08 and e11 outputs, none of which is yet available. It remains
proposed and must distinguish supported observations for this household
from claims about other homes or current conditions. Neither e11 nor e12 has
a verified execution or publication date. The other eleven coverage dates
from March 12 through June 4, 2025 remain unassigned.

The public electricity repository still points to snapshot
[`e69fadb`](https://github.com/dckodi-glitch/electricity-changes/tree/e69fadb3089e96e8dd9ea812559d840dddf13d6c),
whose outputs include only the daily coverage/energy export and the
all-period hourly active-power profile. No distinct source output supports a
new milestone for June 11 through September 3, 2025, so all 13 coverage
dates remain unassigned. This is a gap in available public evidence, not
proof that no work occurred outside GitHub.
